MAINT-DIST-S1.title: Define Distance Calculation Schema and Contract
MAINT-DIST-S1.description: Define input/output contract for distance calculation including coordinates (lat/long), units (miles/km), and response structure (distance, duration if available). Align with existing Pydantic model patterns.

MAINT-DIST-S2.title: Implement Core Distance Calculation Logic
MAINT-DIST-S2.description: Implement backend logic to compute distance between two coordinate pairs using Google Routes logic or fallback calculation. Ensure consistency with existing clinical trials distance computation.

MAINT-DIST-S3.title: Integrate Distance Logic into Services and Facade
MAINT-DIST-S3.description: Integrate distance calculation into relevant domain services (e.g., provider search or clinical trials) and expose via existing facades so distance is included in responses.

MAINT-DIST-S4.title: Distance Calculation Unit and Integration Tests
MAINT-DIST-S4.description: Create unit tests for distance calculations (edge cases, invalid inputs, unit conversions) and integration tests validating end-to-end flow through services and facade.

MAINT-DIST-S5.title: Distance Calculation Fallback and Error Handling
MAINT-DIST-S5.description: Implement fallback logic (e.g., Haversine formula) when Google Routes API fails or is unavailable, including timeout handling, invalid coordinate handling, and graceful degradation of duration data.
MAINT-DIST-S5.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/clinical_trials_service.py (external API dependency implies need for fallback)
